title: Parrot (preview)
card: An African Grey whose Cadence brain hears a preset question as sound and answers in sound. A preview from development.
tagline: A brain that hears and speaks sounds as symbols
kicker: SOUNDS AS SYMBOLS, KEPT IN MEMORY
feature: Each sound the parrot keeps is a record in Cadence's long-term memory, linked to a word by synapses. A preset question reaches its ear as sound, its trained brain settles on an answer, and the answer brings back its sound.
howTo: Pick a question under Ask it and press Ask. Watch each word light as the ear hears it and the answer bring back its sound. Click a thing to put it in focus. Throw a pistachio after a right answer.
